name: Alien Breeding Program: First Contact
source:
Natalie is a regular student in her final year of University. Working hard to wrap up the last of her courses, she's got her whole life planned out. Degree, job, career. But, not all things can be planned for.

When an Alien ship appears above Earth, the world is thrown into chaos. Humanity, stunned to learn it is not alone in the universe, is quickly defeated by the technologically advanced Aliens.
As the world around her begins to fall apart, Natalie strives to keep herself safe. And above all, she wonders why these strange creatures came to her world. What do they want? Why are they here?

Fighting to survive and fighting for answers, Natalie will have to rely on her strength and intelligence as she steps out into a new and unknown world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
娜塔莉是大学最后一年的普通学生。她努力完成最后一门课程，为自己的一生做好了规划。学位、工作、职业。但是，并不是所有的事情都可以计划好。

当一艘外星飞船出现在地球上空时，世界陷入混乱。人类震惊地发现自己在宇宙中并不孤单，很快就被技术先进的外星人击败。
当她周围的世界开始分崩离析时，娜塔莉努力保证自己的安全。最重要的是，她想知道为什么这些奇怪的生物来到她的世界。他们想要什么？他们为什么在这里？

为了生存而战，为了寻找答案，娜塔莉必须依靠自己的力量和智慧，踏入一个新的未知世界。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401080/]Steam[/url]]
